today_summary: GCM26 marked $4,089.8 on the 2026-08-04 session, $16.3 (-0.40%) lower and the third consecutive down session since the 07-31 expiry roll, on a 113-DTE chain at 21.67% ATM IV. Open interest stays extremely call-skewed at P/C OI 0.34 (179,043 vs 60,118), but 85,136 contracts - 48% of all call OI - sit at $6,000 and above, which is what pins headline max pain at $6,500, $2,410 above spot and untradeable. Traded flow is far narrower than the OI implies: $5,000 calls alone took 1,112 of the day's 5,200 call lots (21%), against just 151 put lots at $4,000. Local dealer gamma is negative and worsening - net GEX within +/-$200 of spot is -142.5, stacked at $3,900 (-42.4), $4,000 (-33.9) and $3,950 (-27.8).
five_day_thesis: The 5-day window still straddles a contract roll - the scraped expiry jumped 2 DTE -> 117 DTE on 2026-07-31 - so the headline deltas (max pain $4,795 -> $6,500, call wall $5,370 -> $8,000, put wall $4,000 -> $3,500, ATM IV 17.91% -> 21.67%) measure a change of instrument, not a change of positioning. Comparing only the three post-roll sessions on the same 113-117 DTE chain, spot has fallen $4,159.7 -> $4,089.8 (-$69.9, -1.68%) in a straight line, ATM IV has been flat to lower (22.02% -> 21.67%, -0.35pp), and volume has collapsed 39% on calls (8,530 -> 5,200) and 52% on puts (2,303 -> 1,094). The one metric that moved decisively is dealer gamma: the scraper's +/-20% window total decayed +54.64 -> +9.28 -> -10.65, flipping negative on 08-04, while net GEX within +/-$200 of spot deteriorated -106.4 -> -142.5 in a single session. Both walls are static - the $3,500 put wall added 12 contracts (4,512 -> 4,524) and the $8,000 call wall 150 (24,998 -> 25,148) - so this is not repositioning, it is decay: a long-dated, call-loaded book bleeding its stabilizing gamma while price grinds lower on a thinning tape. Net read: the market has spent three sessions dismantling the cushion that was absorbing downside on 07-31, and nothing in the flow has stepped in to rebuild it.
